messages:
sophie: Heads-up - Biotex wants a non-standard payment flow for the POC -> production deal. They propose a 3-year staircase: full prepay year1, year2 quarterly billing Net90, year3 quarterly with a usage true-up. Need deal desk signoff.
evan: Can you drop the customer's proposed numbers so I can model TCO against our rate card?
sophie: They sent numbers in their procurement email: 
```
Year1: $300,000 prepaid (they expect 22% discount)
Year2: $330,000 billed qtrly (no prepaid)
Year3: $240,000 billed qtrly + up to $60k true-up based on token overage
Total committed: $930,000 over 36 months
```
They also want Net90 on the quarterly invoices for years 2 and 3 and an SLA-linked refund on the pilot.
mike: Net90 on >$900k commit is a hard no without CFO signoff. Our standard is Net30 on qtrly, Net0 or prepaid for commit discounts. Could offer Net60 as a concession but would push the discount back.
sophie: They tied the 22% discount to Year1 prepay in their ask. If we require Net30/Net60 later, they may ask for an extra 3-5% on later years.
priya: Legal/InfoSec note: customer requires proof of SOC2 Type II and a completed security questionnaire before production go-live. That will likely take 2-3 weeks. We should make the SOW dependent on confirmation of security artifacts.
evan: For the POC we can stand up a sandbox if we have an order form or deposit. If Year1 prepay is accepted, that can be the trigger for provisioning. Otherwise POC schedule slips.
finance-bot: reminder: Deals >$750k require CFO approval per deal playbook.
mike: Correct - since total is $930k, this is routed to CFO. My recommendation for approval: accept Year1 prepay with 20% (not 22%) discount, require Net30 for qtrly invoices in years 2/3, include a late-payment clause and interest. If customer insists on Net90 escalate to CFO and propose escrow or letter of credit.
sophie: @mike, please start the CFO routing. Also we need a short clause for pilot refund: customer asked for 10% refundable credit if POC fails to meet agreed latency/throughput SLOs.
evan: We can accept a capped credit equal to 10% of Year1 prepay if SLOs are missed during the POC window. I'll draft measurable SLOs and test harness steps.
priya: I'll prepare the contract addendum with the staircase invoicing, true-up mechanism, discount tie to year1 receipt, Net terms, late fees, and the SLO-driven credit. I'll also add acceptance language contingent on security questionnaire closure.
mike: Looping in CFO now. I'll flag as "requires exec approval" and include finance risk notes.
sophie: I'll tell Biotex procurement we need ~72h for internal approvals and may come back with counter-proposal: 20% on Y1, Net30 on Y2/Y3, and a 10% capped POC credit.
finance-bot: routing: CFO -> pending. routing: legal -> priya. routing: salesops -> mike.
priya: One more: customer asked if we can amortize the prepaid credit over their accounting periods. Finance prefers to recognize when received, but we can add an invoice schedule for their GL if needed.
sophie: Great point. Mike, can finance advise on revenue recognition implications for their accounting team?
mike: Will set finance note and include in CFO packet.
sophie: Thanks everyone — I'll update Biotex after CFO responds. :white_check_mark:
